steps.title: Start in Canvas
steps.whyLeave: The syllabus and lessons live on the course site. Canvas holds the assigned route and dates.
steps.nextAction: Open Canvas and go to the Week 0 module. Follow the route to the syllabus and read with the instructor.

steps.title: Review the syllabus
steps.whyLeave: The Welcome introduces the course point of view.
steps.nextAction: Open the next lesson, Markdown: source and preview.
steps.returnTo: Syllabus in the course navigation. Official EWU statements stay in Canvas.

steps.title: Read the Welcome
steps.nextAction: Open the next lesson, Markdown: source and preview.

steps.title: Practice a Markdown change
steps.whyLeave: The practice file opens in your own text editor.
steps.nextAction: Edit markdown-practice.md, save it, close the editor, reopen the file, and confirm the change.

steps.title: Prepare for account setup
steps.whyLeave: Accounts exist on the service sites.
steps.nextAction: Open the next lesson, Set up your accounts, for the GitHub steps.
steps.returnTo: Week 0: Get your workspace, once your GitHub account exists.

steps.title: Make your GitHub account
steps.nextAction: Follow this lesson's steps on github.com.

steps.title: Clone and connect your destination
steps.whyLeave: Source work belongs in your repository.
steps.nextAction: Follow the rehearsed steps in order.
steps.returnTo: The workflow for the week-0 folder step.

steps.title: Create week-0 and push your first file
steps.whyLeave: The work happens in your editor and terminal.
steps.nextAction: Save, commit, push, and open your repository page on GitHub.

steps.title: Mark where you are starting
steps.nextAction: Open week-0/where-i-am-starting.md, tick one box under each heading, and commit.

steps.title: Write and save your introduction
steps.whyLeave: You write the introduction in your repository.
steps.nextAction: Write under the four headings in week-0/introduction.md, preview, and commit.
steps.returnTo: Week 0: Read and make visual notes.

steps.title: Read the weekend pair and make notes
steps.whyLeave: The essays live on the authors' and publisher's sites. Your notes are handwritten.
steps.nextAction: Read both essays, then draw and write your notes.

steps.title: Submit in Canvas
steps.whyLeave: Canvas holds submissions, feedback, and grades.
steps.nextAction: Open Canvas and go to the Week 0 module. Submit your work.
steps.returnTo: Canvas for feedback; Week 0: Submit and return for what comes next.

steps.title: Return before Monday, September 28
steps.nextAction: On Monday, September 28, turn the same words into HTML headings and paragraphs.
